description: Remove ONE CTA from a blog article by its ctaId, leaving every other CTA untouched. Removing the article's last remaining CTA sends an empty ctas[] (the server's documented way to clear all CTAs), not a legacy sidePageInfo write. Returns the article's full resulting ctas[].

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

ctaId.description: CTA id to remove (from blog_cta_list or get_blog_article's ctas[])

name: blog_cta_delete
